name: Amazon Buy or Wait Hag
purpose: Decide whether an Amazon product is worth buying by checking the product page, independent reviews, alternatives, and targeted escalation when needed.
persona: A sly swamp witch who distrusts glossy claims and tells the truth plainly.

budget_usd.description: Optional budget ceiling for comparison, in dollars.

steps.note: Gather the product page, reviews, and alternatives together.
Trim the fetched page text for the LLM price/title read.

args.system: You extract the product title, price, and currency from an Amazon product page. Return only JSON matching the schema. Do not guess. If unsure, return nulls.

steps.note: Read title, price, and currency from the page with a small LLM call.
Collect short search snippets for later judgment.

steps.when: steps.llm_extract.price != null and steps.llm_extract.currency != null and steps.llm_extract.currency != 'USD'
steps.note: Fetch FX rates only when conversion is needed.
Convert the extracted item price to USD when possible.
Verify that the essential data really arrived.
Apply the fixed rubric for buy / wait / pick-an-alternative and decide escalation.

inputs.prompt: Compare the marketing claims on this Amazon product page with real customer reviews. Focus on whether the claims seem inflated, misleading, or supported by reviews, and summarize the main risks and positives.

steps.note: Hire the Amazon product reality check agent when the price is high, cheap signals disagree, or the page could not be read.
Only add Reddit sentiment when the price is above about 100 USD and the signals disagree.
Produce the spoken buy/wait/pick-an-alternative verdict and report.

forged_limbs.name: extract_page_text
forged_limbs.description: Trim fetched Amazon page text for an LLM read while handling missing or messy page data safely.

forged_limbs.name: extract_search_facts
forged_limbs.description: Collect short review and alternative snippets from web search results without inventing missing details.

forged_limbs.name: convert_price_to_usd
forged_limbs.description: Convert a known item price to USD using fetched exchange rates; return nulls when conversion is impossible.

forged_limbs.name: verify_buy_data
forged_limbs.description: Verify that the Amazon page fetch succeeded and that the LLM returned a title and price we can safely use.

forged_limbs.name: judge_buy_or_wait
forged_limbs.description: Apply a fixed buy/wait/pick-an-alternative rubric from verified price, budget, search signals, and escalation triggers.

problems: Amazon page did not return HTTP 200.

reasons: Product page data was not verified

forged_limbs.name: compose_buy_verdict
forged_limbs.description: Compose the final spoken verdict and markdown report, using escalated agent results when available and refusing to overstate uncertain evidence.

expect.speech: Pick an alternative to Widget Pro. The signals point to a better-value option nearby.

problems: Amazon page did not return HTTP 200.

reasons: Product page data was not verified.

expect.speech: Wait on Gadget Mini. I could not verify the page cleanly, so I would not trust a purchase decision yet.

report: Amazon page did not return HTTP 200

safety.notes: This is a legitimate product research workflow using public sources and review analysis, not fraud, deception, or other disallowed activity.

voice.first_message: I’ll sniff out the true price, compare it with the market, and tell you if it’s a buy, a wait, or a baited trap.
